page.overview:
Who is Dr. Caledonius?

Dr. Caledonius was a character who appears in "Wizard City", and serves as the episode's main antagonist. She was a professor of Magic History at Wiz Arts, and the apparent leader of a cult dedicated to resurrecting Coconteppi.

Finally, she, along with the other members of the cult, are killed by a semi-corrupted Peppermint Butler (Pepperminteppi) after drinking the ichor-laden chalice. She was the last of the cult to fall, nearly being crushed by Coconteppi's heart, which had a lot of ichor in it, causing some to fall into her mouth and make her explode.

She was a tall, brown-skinned humanoid with round white glasses, a four-ring hairstyle, dark brown hair, a blue dress with magenta details, and a white collar. She also has a tattoo of Peppermint Butler on her back.

At first she seemed to be a kind person, interested in the well-being of her students and wanting to make sure they all have fun in her class. She treated Peppermint kindly saying that he is her favorite student and gave her the nickname "Star Bright." However, she was actually evil and intended to search for a student who is worthy of the Chalice and be Coconteppi's successor. She is also shown to be murderous as she ordered Cadebra to be killed when she tried to talk Peppermint out of drinking from the goblet.
